theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U M : Set (Eucl P)) (θ : Eucl P → ℝ) (ξ : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) (m + 1)), IsRectifiableTriple U (m + 1) M θ ξ → ∀ ω : TestFormOn U m, ∃ Y : Eucl P → Eucl P, Integrable Y ((μHE[m + 1] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict M) ∧ (∀ (x : Eucl P) (φ : Eucl P →L[ℝ] ℝ), φ (Y x) = θ x * ξ x (ContinuousAlternatingMap.alternatizeUncurryFin (φ.smulRight ((ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) m) x)))) ∧ ∀ᵐ x ∂((μHE[m + 1] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict M), ∀ Q : Submodule ℝ (Eucl P), HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt (m + 1) M θ x Q → Y x ∈ Q
